I'm feeling a bit overwhelmed right now because I've recently run into some financial troubles, and I really need to sort out my orders with you. I want to cancel any orders that haven't arrived yet, and for the ones that have been delivered, I want to return everything from those orders. The problem is, I don't exactly remember what I ordered, so I would really appreciate it if you could help me by listing all the items from my delivered orders first. I just want to get this all sorted out as soon as possible.

Thank you for the detailed information. Yes, please go ahead and cancel both pending orders #W4836353 and #W7342738. The reason for cancellation is "no longer needed" for both. 

And yes, I want to return every item from the delivered orders #W4597054 and #W7773202 as well. I just want to get everything sorted out quickly because of my financial situation. Please proceed with the cancellations and returns.

I'll keep an eye out for the return instructions email. Thanks again for making this easier for me. Have a good day! ###STOP###
